locator: Figure 2A and results, cell 12 in Tables I and II
preparation: Single Chara corallina internode in artificial pond water. Turgor steps were applied with a pressure probe at 23 ± 2 °C. The initial volume rates were fitted to the first 40 s of each clamp.
uncertainty: The paper gives no uncertainty for these two individual flow estimates. Elasticity measured separately by opposite pressure pulses on this cell gave a local volume modulus of 207 bar.
mapping: The two initial flow responses are compared assuming constant conductance and initial osmolarities fixed during each pressure step. The second step is relative to the new equilibrium baseline.
